description: Groups child elements in a wrapping flex row with configurable alignment and gap.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between clustered items. When absent, uses the --tp-cluster-gap CSS default.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-cluster>` element implements the <tp-icon name="cluster" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Cluster functionality: groups child elements in a wrapping flex row with configurable alignment and gap.
userHelp.interactions:

#### Keyboard interactions
